metadata.name: IntegerQIFNeuron
metadata.author: Wu, W.-C.; Yeh, C.-F.; White, A.J.; Wang, C.-T.; Yeh, Z.-W.; Hsieh, C.-C.; Liu, R.-S.; Tang, K.-T.; Lo, C.-C.
metadata.description: Piecewise-linear integer integrate-and-fire recurrence with Q0.3 slopes

dynamics.v: max(v_min, v + (((a * (v_rest - v)) // 8 if v < branch_point else (b * (v - v_threshold)) // 8) + I))

extensions.coefficient_format: a and b are non-negative Q0.3 numerators; the force is arithmetic-shifted right by three
extensions.branch_point_note: branch_point is trunc((b*v_threshold+a*v_rest)/(a+b)); overrides of a, b, v_rest or v_threshold must supply the recomputed value
extensions.soma_scope_note: The schema implements paper Eq. 2. Paper Eq. 3 is a network-level exponential synaptic-current generator and is not hidden inside the soma.
extensions.source_binding: twetto/iq-neuron commit a8752eba49dba9ba43a64be74090b91a51044b2f, include/iq_neuron.h and src/iq_neuron.cpp; optional noise fixed to zero
extensions.silicon_cosim_note: Q32.0 preserves all source integers and the complete 400-step tutorial trace exactly.
